description: This course is entirely project-based. It allows the student the opportunity to engage in independent learning and research. It also affords the student the chance to delve into topics that may not be present in the regular curriculum. Please note that only 4 Units can be accredited towards major requirements in the case a student undertakes 8 Units for both PC2288/R and PC2289/R.
